alerts.title: Construction
alerts.rawText:
Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day

Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day. Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.
geometryIssues: This notice is published in SEPTA’s service notices and has no detour map.
